def Pg(L,i): return tuple(''.join(L[r][15+7*i:20+7*i]) for r in range(52,57))

        action(['UP'])
        L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        g=Pg(L,col)
        ring.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    rings[col]=ring[:-1]
    print('col',col,'ringlen',len(ring)-1)
for col in range(5):
    print('--- col',col)
    for g in rings[col]: print(g)
